name: Retro Zine
avoid_for: Contexts that demand digital-native polish or fast modern-tech energy — the layered zine aesthetic intentionally feels handmade
weak_cases: Source-size body copy is too small to assume projector readability; many annotations compete with evidence.
visual_signature: Khaki/forest Risograph, condensed display, handwritten notes, tape and paper-offset blocks.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Condensed uppercase, drop caps and handwriting do not transfer mechanically; use script-appropriate hierarchy.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
